title: Move Up to a Better Place

request.style: English, female solo, warm and reflective, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, moderate tempo, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Noticing how the guests chose the places of honor
He told them a parable to guide their hearts
When you are invited to a wedding feast
Do not take the place of honor for safety
For someone more distinguished may have been invited
And the host will ask you to give this man your place

[Chorus]
Go and take the lowest place instead
So the host can say friend move up to a better place
You will be honored in front of all the guests
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled

[Verse]
If you take the highest seat with pride
The shame of moving down will be your fate
But if you sit low with humility
The host will call you up with grace
Friend move up to a better place
And your honor will be seen by all

[Chorus]
Go and take the lowest place instead
So the host can say friend move up to a better place
You will be honored in front of all the guests
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled

[Bridge]
The one who humbles himself will be exalted
This is the truth that Jesus said
Choose the lowest seat to find your worth
Let your pride be laid down like a dead leaf

[Outro]
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled
The one who humbles himself will be exalted
